title: Compute atomic-limit energies and phase boundaries
action: Derive analytic energies per dimer for the polar (PCOI, PCOI') and nonpolar (NPCOI) charge-ordered configurations in the atomic limit (all hopping amplitudes zero). Compute the phase boundaries in the V_p–V_q plane and the degeneracy condition V_p=V_q=(V_{b1}+V_{b2})/2.
description: The analytic energies establish the reference phase competition that the numerical VMC simulations refine. This step produces a text file documenting the derived formulas.

title: Determine phase boundaries for insulating phases from VMC
action: For the large-U regime (U/tb1=10, Vb1/tb1=4, Vb2/tb1=2), perform variational Monte Carlo (Jastrow-Slater wave functions with charge and magnetic order parameters) on a set of Vp and Vq values along the line Vp+Vq=3tb1. Identify the transition points where the lowest-energy phase changes between PCOI, DMI, and PCOI'. Output the phase boundaries as a JSON object.
description: This is the primary scored result for the insulating phase diagram. The boundaries are defined by the crossing of variational energies.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: 'PCOI_to_DMI_Vp_over_tb1' (float), 'DMI_to_PCOI_prime_Vp_over_tb1' (float), and optionally 'NPCOI_region' (boolean, indicating whether the NPCOI phase appears along the scanned line).

title: Compute charge structure factors for insulating phases
action: Using the optimized wave functions from the large-U scan, compute the total charge structure factor N(q) and the charge-disproportionation structure factor N_CD(q) for the stable phases (PCOI, PCOI', NPCOI, DMI) at the representative momenta q=(0,0) and q=(π,π). Output a JSON file with the values.
description: The structure factors confirm the type of charge order (intra-dimer vs inter-dimer) and the absence of order in the DMI phase.
output_schema: JSON object with keys for each phase: 'PCOI', 'PCOI_prime', 'NPCOI', 'DMI'. Each is an object containing: 'N_CD_q00' (float), 'N_CD_qpipi' (float), 'N_qpipi' (float). qpipi denotes q=(π,π).

title: Compute sublattice charge density for 12-sublattice charge-ordered metal
action: In the small-U metallic regime (U/tb1=6, Vb1/tb1=4, Vp/tb1=3.5, Vq/tb1=3), perform VMC simulations with a 12-sublattice auxiliary Hamiltonian to obtain the electron density per sublattice. Output a CSV file with the density values for the c and f orbitals on each of the 12 sublattices.
description: This quantifies the honeycomb-like charge-ordered metal phase. The density pattern should exhibit a rich-rich-poor sequence across the 12 sublattices.
output_schema: CSV with 3 columns: 'sublattice' (integer 0–11), 'density_c' (float), 'density_f' (float). Each row corresponds to one sublattice.
